name: Dr Kimberly Mercuri
title: Clinical Psychologist, Director
description: Dr. Kim utilises various psychological interventions but is primarily informed by Schema Therapy. Dr. Kim also utilises Eye Movement Desensitisation Reprocessing (EMDR) which is an evidence-based psychological therapy to help reduce the impact of past experiences that are negatively impacting on a person's present-day life. Consults in Coburg and Prahran.

name: Charlie Haddad
title: Social Worker & Counsellor (EMDR)
description: Holds Advanced Training in Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR); full member of EMDRAA and EMDRIA. Charlie's practice is trauma-informed, strengths-based and person-centred. Charlie is dedicated to providing inclusive and affirming support to BIPOC, LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent communities across the lifespan, and supports people experiencing trauma, anxiety, relationship difficulties, grief and loss, and emotional regulation difficulties.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, LGBTQIA+, BIPOC, neurodivergent, children and teens
